Bradesco, a leading Brazilian bank, has teamed with evolvingQ to launch initial tests of quantum‑communication methods aimed at assessing new data‑protection frameworks. The experiments focus on evaluating the feasibility and security benefits of quantum‑based encryption for financial transactions. These trials represent an early step toward integrating quantum technologies into Brazil’s banking infrastructure.
